maya: Morning — async standup: what I did / blockers / today
maya: did: finished staging canary for the new route-fallback policy, pushed config (PR #8123)
maya: blocker: seeing intermittent 502s on long-poll streaming when auth-proxy reconnects, looks timing-related
maya: today: triage logs, add unit test, push potential reconnect fix, re-run canary
sam: can repro locally with a tight reconnect loop, can you paste the staging log snippet?
maya: staging logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-06-12T09:13:02Z] auth-proxy: connection lost -> reconnecting (id=32)
[2026-06-12T09:13:03Z] gateway: stream write failed: write tcp 10.0.5.7:443->10.0.8.9:51122: broken pipe
[2026-06-12T09:13:03Z] gateway: returning 502 to client (route=chat.stream)
```
carmen: quick note — yesterday's rate limiter tweak reduced burst tokens to 200 for the low-latency lane. doc PR #8129 open to reflect change :memo:
arjun: planning KMS kid rotation tonight 02:00 UTC. will roll through canary lane first. if anyone expects stable kid, please call it out now
maya: @arjun can we accept previous kid for ~15m grace? saw tokens minted 5m pre-rotate fail in staging
arjun: yes, I'll add a 15m grace window in the rotation script, good catch
trent: pushed a tiny change to routing policy: prefer region-match before cost-tier to reduce cross-region chatter. canary at 10% now (PR #8135) :rocket:
sam: maya — to repro streaming 502s try: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://staging-gw.redwood.local/v1/chat/stream?route=chat.stream&sleep=0.2"
```
then kill auth-proxy and bring it back, observe 502s
maya: thanks, will run that and attach results to PR. toggled canary back to 0% for now while we triage :pause_button:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: gateway-route-policy v1.9.2 -> staging (build #4821)
carmen: FYI muted noisy alert `gateway.stream.err_rate` for 30m while we investigate — will unmute when fixed
maya: update: root cause looks like race between KV cache invalidation and auth-proxy reconnect; token validation path reads stale cache and then fails mid-stream. drafting fix to delay invalidation by ~200ms
maya: PR incoming in ~30m, will request review from @sam and @trent
sam: grabbing review slot now, will push comments within the hour
arjun: I'll run a dry-run of key rotation in staging after the fix is up and report status in #incidents if anything odd
trent: if the fix looks small we can merge to staging and run a 5% canary, let me know when ready
maya: will aim to merge by EOD. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
